title: Buffer Overflow / Memory Corruption (Injection)
description: A buffer overflow in a native application or service allows specially crafted input to overwrite memory and control execution flow. Attackers may achieve arbitrary code execution or denial of service.
businessImpact: High --- remote code execution could allow full system compromise, data exfiltration, tampering with business-critical systems, and lengthy recovery times that disrupt operations.
remediation:
- Apply vendor patches or rebuild with mitigations (stack canaries, ASLR, DEP/NX).
- Validate and sanitize all inputs, perform bounds checking.
- Conduct fuzz testing and code review to identify overflow conditions.
- Isolate vulnerable services via segmentation or sandboxing.
